Hayworth Market
Summer Sale: July 1-30
We grow everything right here on our farm.
Look in the Falls Creek newspaper for a
coupon good for 10% off any single item
over $10.00.
Apple cider: $2.50 for one gallon
Blueberries: $2.35 per carton
Fruit pie (assorted varieties): $9.50 each
Tomato plant: $10.50 each
Visit us Tuesday-Sunday, 9 A.M.-6 P.M.
102 Sellar Road, Falls Creek, PA 15840
